marketLayer.title: HK Tech Stocks & Southbound Capital Inflows
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index saw increased volume today as Southbound capital recorded a net inflow of HKD 5.2 billion, with major allocations focused on Tencent, Meituan, and Xiaomi.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained liquidity support from mainland institutional investors is helping establish a valuation floor for major internet platform companies ahead of the upcoming earnings season.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Quarterly earnings guidance from key platform players and potential macro policy shifts in mainland China.

marketLayer.title: US Semiconductor CapEx & AI Hardware Demand
marketLayer.fact: Leading US hyperscalers reiterated elevated CapEx guidance aimed at AI infrastructure, boosting sentiment across semiconductor supply chains and hardware equipment providers.
marketLayer.inference: High capital spending commitments from major cloud providers offer strong near-term revenue visibility for top GPU suppliers and foundry leaders.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: The pace of enterprise AI monetization and potential supply chain bottlenecks in advanced packaging.

marketLayer.title: Fed Rate Path & HK Banking Sector Yields
marketLayer.fact: US 10-year Treasury yields held steady following mixed economic data, while HIBOR rates saw mild recalibration, influencing Hong Kong high-dividend banking stocks.
marketLayer.inference: Stabilizing net interest margins (NIM) continue to support attractive dividend yields for Hong Kong banking majors, drawing defensive yield-seeking capital.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: The exact timing and magnitude of Federal Reserve rate adjustments in the second half of the year.
